notes.title: Security Log #1 - The Trapper & Traps
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,  Welcome to our first of many dev updates! For this first one, we'll delve into the Trapper![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/b22a893dcea0264b25b2ce9a7535eb7cc8f77bfd.gif"][/img]  Shockingly, the Trapper is all about traps. Homing rockets, bombs, shock traps, hammer fists, water guns etc. Any previously docile piece of furniture can become something of nightmares. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/f81a4291835dc477e3d11c3ce853e594fa15efcf.jpg"][/img]Yes, that is [i]a toilet with eyes being propelled by a rocket.[/i] 

Prior to the Bandits arriving, the Trapper has a few minutes to booby trap the house to make sure the Bandits aren't successful in looting the house. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/391f147f5d08b38988de5abdd4e47f1a77316f4b.gif"][/img]   In each map, there are towers placed around the environment. The Trapper can enter these to place traps in the furniture-they're also able to travel between each tower quickly. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/11bfd709c251711a315ee0061918c57ecacad920.gif"][/img]Traps are automatically activated when Bandits are near the trap or interact with it. As the Trapper, you are able to enter that piece of furniture and personally drive it around and activate the trap at your leisure. So yes, feel free to fly around in a bookcase and chase the Bandits.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/053f2304afb1032ed2eb379abe534be4e79621d3.gif"][/img]
In addition, you can manually activate traps while in a tower once the Bandits have breached the house. To maximize chaos, a smart Trapper will launch traps in tandem with others to hit the Bandits with a "combo." In the gif below, a shock ball is bouncing around while the Trapper simultaneously launches a tornado.
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/46958592f8916586cc978ca4e1b03766a72f3b88.gif"][/img]
The chaotic gameplay of Bandit Trap is driven by our wacky physics engine. For example, if a Bandit sets off a water bomb on the second level of a house-water will cascade to the first floor of the house causing it to flood. Bandits are much more exposed while swimming.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/0f9749c99e6a8aceb785486e33387179049c55c9.gif"][/img]All the walls in a level are fully destructible, opening up tons of emergent gameplay moments for both the Trapper and Bandit. Be careful to not accidentally knock down a wall and give Bandits easier access into a room. But also don't be afraid to break down a wall to send a Bandit flying!
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/8818770897799e2384151f66c8659a139fbf0bc7.gif"][/img]
In addition, we’ve improved friend matchmaking a lot: [/p][list][*][p]Friends that have been invited stay invited after each session![/p][/*][*][p]You can now kick friends during matchmaking[/p][/*][*][p]You can now make a friend leader of a match[/p][/*][*][p]You can now re-assign / swap roles for Bandit / Trapper once friends are in a room,[/p][/*][/list][p] More on our to-do list: [/p][list][*][p]Being able to quickly rematch the last session[/p][/*][*][p]Quick next match session


Thanks for reading and we'll see you in the next dev log!

[url="https://discord.gg/ctRpYZ9"]Join the Discord![/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Bandit Trap!
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome Trappers and Bandits to the very best home security system training program!

Bandit Trap is a wacky, physics driven 3v1 multiplayer game where you ransack a house for loot or defend it!

As the Bandits, players must work together to search the house for gems that are hidden within furniture- all while trying to avoid the deadly traps set up by the Trapper. 
[/p][p]The match ends once the Trapper inflicts enough damage to the Bandits or the Bandits find all the gems. Rounds usually last around 10 minutes! Let's take a quick peek at how that works.[/p][h2]Trapper[/h2][p]At the beginning of each match is a 2 min prep period where the Trapper prepares the house for the soon to be coming Bandits. This is the time where the Trapper can booby trap the home. Rigging furniture with tools of destruction like bombs or flamethrowers. But it goes a step further than that, Trappers can combine items for even deadlier traps. For example, combining an ice turret with a bomb creates an ice bomb. And yes, definitely add a homing rocket to the race car bed for it to chase down a Bandit.[/p][p]Once the Bandits enter the house, the Trapper can enter furniture to manually control it. Also being able to activate the traps placed within them-otherwise the traps will auto activate once Bandits are near. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/11bfd709c251711a315ee0061918c57ecacad920.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Bandits[/h2][p]
While the Trapper spends a couple minutes booby trapping the house, Bandits are able to plan their point of entry and decide their loadout. Along with being able to practice with the myriad of tools they'll need to accomplish their objective. These poor folks can be burned, squashed, flung through walls, frozen, and everything in between-but they are resilient! Once a Bandit reaches a certain damage threshold, they'll need assistance from a teammate to be revived.

Once inside the house, scan and destroy furniture to find Gems! Reaching 10 means Victory! But watch out for all the Traps![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/60994230222eb634230191df8e6c70be5c08c9ab.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FctRpYZ9"]Join the Discord![/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Available + Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Greetings Bandits and Trappers,

Ahead of the upcoming Next Fest, we've gone ahead and turned on the Bandit Trap demo! Hop in and check out the tutorials for both bandits+trappers, play against bots, Online, or play against a group of your friends! 

We've updated the demo as well:
[list]
[*] Updated in-game EULA.
[*] Lots of improvements to player climbing system.
[*]  Fixed an issue causing bots to get stuck when attempting to navigate to certain targets.
[*] Fixed a rare issue causing bots to get stuck when attempting to use the grinder weapon.
[*] Fixed an issue causing bots to make incorrect judgements while using the VR scanner.
[*] UX / UI improvements
[*] Quality of Life improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta Number 2
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Bandits and Trappers!

Our second closed beta starts on April 5! We will have two different play sessions. One on April 5 and another on April 6. The times for each region are below. Please make sure to change your server to the correct server listed below. European players need to be on the EU Server and players in North America need to be on the US West server. You can change the server via the menu button on the top right of the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049836/7a17b72cc787b20f93f98bb78d30710b5d5ca69f.png[/img]

EU Server CET: 12PM - 15PM
USA WEST Server ET: 12PM - 7PM EST

For feedback on the beta or to find a group to play with,[url=https://discord.gg/ctRpYZ9] join the Discord! [/url]

Thank you very much in advance for your feedback!
